key_insight: Keyhole TIG welding extends conventional GTAW into a stable single-pass, full-penetration process for medium to thick sections, improving productivity without the complexity of multi-pass edge preparation.
engineering_relevance: It offers a cost-effective, simpler alternative to plasma, laser, and electron-beam welding for industrial fabrication where full penetration and high throughput are needed.
method: Reviewed microstructural evolution in keyhole TIG welds
Synthesized multiphysics numerical modeling and emerging process variants
evidence_signal: The paper is a comprehensive review that integrates prior research rather than reporting a new experimental dataset, organizing evidence from microstructure, monitoring, modeling, and variant process studies.
watch_item: True keyhole mode is still constrained by weld pool stability, so process window control remains critical for reliable industrial deployment.
paper_title: Recent developments and current status of keyhole TIG welding: A comprehensive review
